chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both), that he said:
Indeed the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) called the call to prayer (Adhan) in the ear of Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) with the word 'Salah' on the day he was born.

key_terms.يَوْمَ وُلِدَ: On the day he was born

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say in Hasan's ear at birth?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the unique spiritual status of Imam al-Hasan (AS) by linking his birth directly to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), who recited the Adhan into his ear. In Shia tradition, this act signifies the establishment of the Ahl al-Bayt's authority and the intrinsic connection between the Imams and the divine call to worship, reinforcing their role as the spiritual successors of the Prophet.
